full_name: Jerry R. Green | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Social Sciences Suzanne Young Murray Fellow Harvard University
bio: An economic theorist, Jerry R. Green is the John Leverett Professor in the University and the David A. Wells Professor of Political Economy in the Department of Economics at Harvard University, where he began his academic career in 1970.
